sources.title: MetaCogAgent: A Metacognitive Multi-Agent LLM Framework with Self-Aware Task Delegation
principles: combine current uncertainty with historical capability profile
treat disagreement between self-report and historical competence as second-order uncertainty
update capability boundaries from outcome feedback

sources.title: Agentic Uncertainty Quantification
principles: uncertainty should be an active control signal rather than passive telemetry
target reflection or evidence acquisition only when uncertainty warrants it

sources.title: Memory for Autonomous LLM Agents: Mechanisms, Evaluation, and Emerging Frontiers
principles: memory is a write-manage-read control loop
filter writes and handle contradiction before retrieval
evaluate memory in decision loops rather than static recall only

sources.title: Universe Routing: Why Self-Evolving Agents Need Epistemic Control
principles: route to an epistemic framework before applying specialized reasoning
continual modular routing can reduce forgetting
